mapper.select:
SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, IFNULL(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, C.FINPROD_NAME as customerName, IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, (CASE WHEN IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) END) as usedAmtTotal,
(IFNULL(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-(CASE WHEN IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) END)/100000000 as remainAmt FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('02') inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.FINPROD_ID left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on A.SEQNO=E.SEQNO
A.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND A.PFLSH LIKE concat_ws('','%',#{pflsh},'%')
AND DATE_FORMAT(A.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')<=#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}
AND #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE} < = DATE_FORMAT(A.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')
order by A.VDATE desc

select MM.* from ( SELECT 'root' as pid, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, IFNULL(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, C.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName, IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, (CASE WHEN IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) END) as usedAmtTotal,
(IFNULL(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-(CASE WHEN IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) END)/100000000 as remainAmt
'02' as hasChildren FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('03') inner join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on A.SEQNO=E.SEQNO
union all
SELECT A.SEQNO pid, A.FINPROD_ID customerId, A.PFLSH AS PFLSH, NULL AS creditAmt, B.VDATE VDATE, B.MDATE MDATE, C.FINPROD_ABBR as customerName, IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, (CASE WHEN IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ IFNULL(E.TRADE_AMT,0) END)/100000000 as usedAmtTotal,
null as remainAmt, '01' as hasChildren FROM (select m.seqno,m.finprod_id,n.pflsh from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL m inner join CREDIT_LINES n on m.seqno=n.customer_id) A inner join CREDIT_LINES B on A.FINPROD_ID=B.CUSTOMER_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on B.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on B.SEQNO=E.SEQNO ) MM
MM.customerId IN (#{item} )
AND MM.PFLSH LIKE concat_ws('','%',#{pflsh},'%')
AND DATE_FORMAT(MM.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')<=#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}
AND #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE} < = DATE_FORMAT(MM.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')
order by MM.VDATE desc

if.test: parentId == null or parentId == '' or parentId=='root'.toString()
